description: NT DIPL - Tennant Creek Super Tuesday Bike Counts (Points) 2019 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Northern Territory Government - Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics. This dataset presents information and locations related to The Super Tuesday Bike Count event in Tennant Creek for 2019. The counts are presented as individual points which relate to the location where the counts were undertaken by volunteers. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Northern Territory Government - Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics. Its tags are bicycle. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
